column1: # EU Building Stock Observatory (BSO) -- Spain residential indicators
# Used by 03_heat_intensity.py for (1) the unknown-cohort stock-weighted
# fallback intensity (stock_pct_es column) and (2) the BSO reconciliation row.
# stock_pct_es: share of the Spanish residential stock by construction cohort.
#   Spain had a large 1990s-2000s building boom. Distribution approximated from
#   heat intensity (delivered). DERIVED from the Spanish TABULA per-cohort
#   class-average space-heating need x retrofit blend (0.9175) + DHW. The EU
#   Building Stock Observatory portal could not be queried directly.
